notes.title: The Dream Garden Update is Here!
notes.notes:
This is a major update to Nekokami: Internship - The Dream Garden update!

The Dream Garden is a quiet sanctuary for Planetary Architects. In this secondary game mode, you can create your world peacefully, without objectives or mischievous cats or interruptions. You are the master of your dream, after all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872160/096ac56cf54d47385beda2ac1e9c3194ac067ace.gif[/img]
[i]The mysterious Torii of the Dream Garden. [/i]

In Nekokami: Internship, you unlock more random Tiles for the Dream Garden by progressing in the main game mode - the Story Mode. In the full game, the Dream Garden will come with a wide array of options and have a unique system of progression. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872160/59af8727badda0aaf0b6790636a67dfc85fd33a4.png[/img]

Other changes in this major patch:
[list]
[*] A Graphics option to remove visual effects that may cause dizziness
[*] Further enhancement to the BGM system 
[*] Improvements in localizations
[/list]

Nekokami, the full game, is approaching Early Access release as we continue to involve you, our player community in making the game the best experience possible. We thank you for your continuing support!

Oh we have an updated trailer as well!

[previewyoutube=hjRnjq7I9z0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Road to Version 1.0
notes.notes:
Hello Planetary Architects!

Nekokami: Internship is getting to version 1.0 soon! We are working hard on both the full game as well this important milestone version of the the prologue.

One of the highlight is that we will be adding a prototype Quickmode that allows our Planetary Architects interns to start individual short gameplay sessions right from the menu. Perfect when, say, you are on Steam Deck, or just want to sneak in for some fun during a lunch break! :D We will be sharing more details and some screenshots soon.

Version 1.0 doesn't mean we won't be improving it in the future, though. When we have new features in the full game, we will always see if some part of it can come to the prologue, as a demo.

It's so improper if we end the update without posting some screenshot right?! Here's something what we have been working on. Hm.... what's waiting for our Planetary Architects in the full game.... a jolly cat, a flower, or both...!? And what awaits everyone in the desert?!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872160/24b827eadb411990aff2e5cc8304d190eb91b20e.png[/img]

notes.title: Simplified Chinese Localization Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hi Planetary Architects! Just to let you know that we have uploaded a new build with Simplified Chinese localization.

notes.title: 日本語ローカライズ利用可能！
notes.notes:
『ネコカミ』へのご関心、誠にありがとうございます。『ネコカミ: インターンシップ』の日本語ローカライズが利用可能になったことをお知らせいたします。お待たせして申し訳ございません！

ゲームは開発中であり、常に変化しているため、ほとんどのダイアログの翻訳が最終版ではないことがあります。ゲーム内で言語に関する問題が発生した場合は、Steamのゲームフォーラムで提案してください。

無料のプロローグでは、すべての問題に対処できない可能性がありますが、正式版の発売後にはローカライゼーションの改善に努めますので、ご安心ください。

お時間を割いていただき、誠にありがとうございました。今後ともインディーズゲームをどうぞよろしくお願いいたします！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872160/500c592e0bab3090729de58a95c7df14972a8c15.png[/img]

notes.title: Japanese Version coming Next Week! 日本語版は来週です！
notes.notes:
Ah, it's an indescribable feeling when you've grown up playing Japanese games and now you have your own game in Japanese.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872160/892156deca82582a1403cbc641eecdb39c8a9f0f.png[/img]

Our UI style is actually inspired by a classic Japanese game from long, long ago. Maybe that's why it looks so natural with Japanese localization?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872160/5de5d7b29052c202770c6de7d82ee0b3a623bdd0.png[/img]

Simplified Chinese version will be upcoming next. Thank you for everyone's support and praises for the prologue around the world!

notes.title: Update 0.97
notes.notes:
Hello Planetary Architects, 
 
This is a major patch that polishes some of the rough edges of the original release. Our deepest gratitude to the support and feedback from all of you. 

NEW: Kami arrival and Kami conversation screens have been revamped. 

NEW: Many tips and hints will now show on the new Chatting system instead popping up as a formal dialog 

NEW: QoL dialog options now available  [list]
[*] Option for increased dialog speed and simplified instructions 
[*] Pause menu can now be activated during dialogs 
[*] Right click can now be used to continue conversations 
[/list]Misc: 
[list]
[*] The Hexagon now appear slightly faster 
[*] Many button or input cooldowns have been reduced 
[*] Objectives will now count as complete even when they contain Undo'able Tiles 
[*] Clouds will no longer stay forever erroneously 
[*] Polished writing across the board 
[*] Various user interface changes in preparation for upcoming localizations 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872160/52b4dbb0a99710b829930909e552b211cfdaeb58.png[/img]

If you have finished everything in the Prologue already, please don't be disappointed with the lack of new content! Know that these improvements will be in the full game as well. We are actually working hard on the full game in parallel. Hope we can share you some sneak peeks soon! 

Thank you for your attention. 

Rocket-in-Bottle Team

notes.title: A Visual Preview of Upcoming Improvements
notes.notes:
We covered some of the upcoming improvements in last week's update, but today we'd like to give everyone a visual sneak peek.

Sometimes the improvement is purely cosmetic. Say, we believe that talking to a cat spirit should feel different from talking to your cat colleagues...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872160/2dd2c5681455e3154cbc13c694ac485da02a7487.png[/img]

We actually revamped the entire dialog system so the chatty cats will interrupt your gameplay less. Yeah I know, this is unrealistic. Real-life cats just LOVE to interrupt humans:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872160/561f8e4b895e61e91feb5b8226e6b61bdf25cdb9.png[/img]

As mentioned, we are adding more gameplay options, so we want to ensure players are informed:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872160/52b4dbb0a99710b829930909e552b211cfdaeb58.png[/img]

Please note that the screenshots show a work in progress. They are subject to change.

By the way, if you've made suggestions to us, we always add your invaluable feedback to our big list of possible improvements. Most of the time, we can't implement them right into the upcoming update, but they are definitely not forgotten.

Thank you for reading! Hope you have a great weekend.

notes.title: Upcoming Features and Improvements
notes.notes:
The prologue is getting over 15000 downloads! That's probably a small number for Steam, but for a first time indie, it is huge. We're receiving valuable feedback from testers through both public and private channels. We are excited and overwhelmed at the same time.

The Prologue and the game as a whole is a work in progress, so please keep the feedback coming! It's a good time to share what we are working on, too:

[list]
[*]Japanese Localization: It is making good progress now. Thank you for your patience!
[*]Chinese Localization: Same here. If you are a bilingual Chinese player and have tried the Prologue already, it would be greatly appreciated if you could share your experience and, if you have any, suggestions.
[*]Kami Interface: It's a bit simple at launch. We are making some secret improvements so it will feel more "right".
[*]Dialog Quality-of-Life: Fast forward buttons, etc. are missing at launch. This caused inconveniences for some players (Sorry about that!). We have moved it up the priority list.
[/list]

Thank you for reading this. We hope that the Prologue continues to bring enjoyment to even more players!
